notes.title: Pineapple Smash Crew Update Released
notes.notes:
- Added Difficulty Modes:
- Easy: classic mode
- Merc: Limited recruits, radiation leak timer, level failed if mercs die
- Pro Merc: No spare recruits, radiation leak timer, game over if mercs die
- Headgear customisation system
- Hall of fame to record victorious and fallen mercs

notes.title: Pineapple Smash Crew Update Released
notes.notes:
- faster initial game load
- added key customization menu
- added resolution options at startup
- added keys for instant merc-switching (default 1-4)
- fixed 'infinite credit' spawning bug
- fixed bug involving interaction of grenade select menu and console display
- fixed bug allowing escape into the void at first entry airlock

notes.title: New Release - Pineapple Smash Crew
notes.notes:
Winner of the 2011 Eurogamer Indie Arcade Award, Pineapple Smash Crew is Now Available on Steam and 10% off until Thursday February 9th 10AM PST.

Pineapple Smash Crew is a fast paced tactical blast-em-up that features tight squad formation shooting, aliens, robots, zombies and grenades- loads and loads of grenades! It's unique modern-retro flavour will take you back to the classics of old then smash you back into the present with a 'ka-boom!'
